findings: Implementation source identity caches Git commit/status per process; shared CLI/MCP/graph presentation equality is consistency, not executable attestation.
Unknown Git information remains unknown in machine and text presentation.
Numeric source_commit produces raw TypeError in format validation; no acceptance demonstrated.
In-band tests inject version-bearing transcripts and compare nonce/identity; they do not execute or authenticate a real backend binary.
Doctor test replaces health and version probes; MCP root-isolation tests create synthetic local roots and check declarations land separately.
remaining: Review full diagnostic/schema surface implementation, rather than infer it from passing surface tests.
General backend identity authenticity and runtime artifact binding remain distinct from implementation metadata.
Disposition stronger source identity requirements without silently adopting an attestation policy.
